researchNotes: Six new restaurant branches: four October9Tokyo openings, November25Tako8 Kyoto and October1Kitahama porc Osaka, plus an existing Moriokake profile enriched without replacing its photographed food board. Exact dates are branch-specific and independent of museum/gallery or former tenant dates.

Four current Tabelog-managed branch menus supersede some older launch hours. Guu Monday closure/22:30closing and booking fees preserved; HoaHoa14:00/21:00last orders and Tuesdayclosure preserved; LALA PASTA closes22:30. Yohaku holidays require confirmation because operator/plan and current listing differ.

Guu art plate is dinner-only, advance booking, one dish¥3,850tax included, not an all-day buffet or full dinner course. Template17–23/two-hourstay conflicts with current22:30close/21:30last order; scheduled ordering17–21:30TueSun. Underlying firstMondayholidayOct12not modelled retrospectively; no remaining Monday public holiday beforeNov17expiry.
Guu buffet supplement¥1,320requires a separate main and has60-minute limit. Four-and-under sharing and5–9children’s tariff retained. Duplicate menu sections deduplicated by item name and price.

LALA PASTA base tax-inclusive prices retained; shape upgrades¥200/¥300have unclear tax basis. Six unclear LALA wine producer translations held, plus guu’s unclear champagne label. Specific bottle size/vintage not invented. Bouquet cocktail¥2,420startsOct9while supplies last; no invented end date or Specials eligibility.

Tako8 Otesuji operator branch page and ALCO onsiteposter confirmNov25at11:30. Storefront image is promotional, not independently verified completed photography. Actual branded takoyaki, torotaku and octopus pot rice names published, but takeout¥580sign/from¥600banner conflict; uncertain food tariffs withheld. Ordinary¥180/¥360drink tax basis unknown.

Tako8 opening five-day¥99all-drinks campaign datesNov25–29are known and displayed in ordinary menu; unverified full daily hours prevent an all-service native schedule. Exact16–18happy-hour¥97excludingbeer is scheduled fromopening with no artificial expiry. Price overlap with¥99requires branch clarification, not invented stacking/precedence. Stale navigation points to sibling Tebasuke menu/hours/booking, excluded. Inaccessible employer11–25snippet not treated as verified current hours.

Morioka-ke source station metadata incorrectly saysNishisen6despiteSusukinoaddress/access; retained written address/branch phone. Existing five-item priced obanzai board was found on the separate menu-photo page and visually reverified; it is preserved alongside the original pin and gallery. Four new unpriced drink categories added. Unlabelled food photographs not used to infer menu items; regular twoSundayclosures need dates.
